title: Forward Deployed Engineering
subtitle: From Ambiguous Workflow to Production Outcome
description: A practical field book for converting ambiguous customer workflows into secure, adopted, supportable production systems and reusable product learning.
author: Komal Nakrani

chapters.title: The Deployed Outcome
chapters.summary: Define the Forward Deployed Engineer's unit of accountability, lifecycle, role boundary, and evidence-based meaning of done.

chapters.title: Enter the Customer System
chapters.summary: Plan legitimate discovery, distinguish stakeholder dimensions, minimize access and data, and keep evidence confidence explicit.

chapters.title: Map the Workflow That Actually Exists
chapters.summary: Model actors, decisions, state, data, tools, handoffs, incentives, exceptions, and failure cost without idealizing the current workflow.

chapters.title: Contract for an Outcome
chapters.summary: Turn workflow evidence into measurable outcomes, guardrails, adoption signals, decision rights, assumptions, non-goals, and exit criteria.

chapters.title: Scope the First Safe Production Path
chapters.summary: Select the least exposed end-to-end path that produces representative production evidence with explicit dependencies, uncertainty, change, and stop criteria.

chapters.title: Draw the Real System Boundary
chapters.summary: Express structural, runtime, data, trust, failure, and responsibility boundaries with explicit ownership and architecture decisions.

chapters.title: Make Interfaces and Data Explicit
chapters.summary: Design versioned API, event, and data contracts with explicit semantics, quality, idempotent intent, exceptions, and reconciliation.
